##### Project general facts

LIV Marina is a contemporary waterfront residential tower by LIV Developers offering a collection of studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as exclusive penthouses. Rising 44 storeys, the project is designed to maximize natural light, open space, and panoramic views through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows and thoughtfully planned layouts. The architecture and interiors reflect a modern luxury aesthetic, while the residences feature open-plan living areas, generous ceiling heights, and carefully curated design details that create an elegant and comfortable living environment.

Residents enjoy access to a full floor of lifestyle amenities designed for leisure, wellness, and social interaction. The development offers a comprehensive selection of recreational and relaxation facilities, creating a resort-inspired residential experience that caters to both active and leisurely lifestyles. The amenity offering is designed to enhance everyday living while providing spaces for fitness, entertainment, and community engagement.

The residences feature high-quality finishes and premium materials throughout. Interiors include open and airy floor plans with 3-meter ceilings, luxury wardrobes, designer bathrooms with richly veined stone countertops, tiled walls, walk-in showers, and soaking tubs. Kitchens are fitted with custom Italian cabinetry, marble quartz countertops, and chef-inspired layouts designed with meticulous attention to detail. Residences are available in both furnished and unfurnished options, offering flexibility to suit different lifestyle preferences.

##### Location description and benefits 

Dubai Marina is an iconic waterfront community that embodies urban sophistication and luxury along the shores of Dubai. Known as one of the city’s most sought-after neighborhoods, it offers a captivating mix of modern living, leisure, and stunning views. At its heart lies a man-made canal stretching over three kilometers, surrounded by high-rise towers and upscale waterfront residences, creating a distinctive and vibrant skyline.  

The community offers residents a luxurious lifestyle with world-class amenities, including fine dining restaurants, trendy cafes, and upscale shopping malls. The Marina Walk provides a scenic promenade for leisurely strolls, lined with restaurants and entertainment venues that overlook the tranquil waters. Additionally, the Dubai Marina Yacht Club adds to the allure, attracting yacht enthusiasts and serving as a picturesque venue for events and waterfront relaxation.  

Dubai Marina is strategically connected to the rest of the city through the Dubai Metro and major highways, ensuring convenient access to business districts, entertainment hubs, and renowned landmarks. Its prime location along the Arabian Gulf also offers opportunities for water sports, yachting, and other maritime activities, making it an ideal destination for both residents and visitors seeking a blend of luxury and convenience.
